description: Needs hardware (not reachable from the dev machine). Sideload the dev server (pnpm dev:https + evenhub qr) and open ?bench=live&wav=/fixtures/dev/two_cities_16k.wav with stt=moonshine-streaming-tiny-en, -small-en, -medium-en and moonshine-base-en on an Android phone and an iPhone inside the Even app (and in Chrome/Safari). Read the [bench] line from chrome://inspect / Safari Web Inspector. Record load ms, sttComputePerNewAudio, interim/final lag, degradation level, crossOriginIsolated/threads/webgpu. Decide per-platform defaults (Small vs Tiny) and whether the TS fallback (kdl.10) is needed. Simulator reference numbers are on irl-subt-kdl.7 and irl-subt-kdl.9.
title: Device run: live caption bench on Android and iOS Even app (Moonshine Streaming vs Base)
